items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I guess when I was about 15 or 16, I took lessons from Lee Young.

ctx.x: Okay, let’s go back to your early training. Apparently this old man, as you said, he must have been hiring you so you’re working with him, but who was training you? Who trained you on your instrument? You said you bought a snare drum and then you say you had a drum set. There’s a big difference playing snare drum and drum set.
I’m more or less self-taught. I’m self-taught. I guess when I was about 15 or 16, I took lessons from Lee Young.
